challenges.title: Grid capacity and discom approvals
challenges.description: DT (distribution transformer) capacity at proposed sites is often inadequate for 60 kW+ fast chargers. TANGEDCO HT/LT sanction can take 90-180 days; load augmentation (new transformer) adds 4-9 months.
challenges.impact: Delays site activation by 3-9 months; ~22% of CapEx is locked unproductively during approval.
solutions: Pre-screen sites using TANGEDCO 11 kV feeder maps; reject sites where existing DT headroom < 100 kVA.
Co-locate with battery energy storage (BESS, 100-250 kWh) to shave demand peaks and avoid HT upgrade.
Apply under TN EV Policy 2023 'single-window' clearance — committed 45-day sanction for designated EV stations.

challenges.title: Real-estate cost and site availability inside Chennai
challenges.description: Prime corridor sites (OMR, ECR, Anna Salai, Mount Rd) command INR 180-350/sqft/month rent; 4-bay DC fast site needs 1500-2500 sqft.
challenges.impact: Rent is 28-40% of OpEx, which is the largest single cost line and stretches payback to 4-5 years.
solutions: Partner with malls (Phoenix, Express Ave, Forum) on revenue-share (12-18% of energy revenue) instead of fixed rent.
Tie up with HPCL/IOCL/BPCL retail outlets — fuel stations have spare frontage, sanctioned HT supply, and EV co-location is encouraged under MoPNG 2022 guidelines.
Use TN govt PPP land bank (Greater Chennai Corp, CMDA) which offers 30-year lease at concessional rate for public charging.

challenges.title: Charger utilization below break-even
challenges.description: Median utilization across TN public DC chargers is 8-12% (vs ~20% needed for 3-year payback). Many AC chargers sit idle outside peak commuting windows.
challenges.impact: Negative unit economics on ~40% of public stations; operators are subsidizing.
solutions: Dynamic pricing: peak/off-peak rates (INR 22 peak, INR 14 off-peak) to spread demand.
B2B fleet contracts (Ola, Uber, BluSmart, Lithium Urban, Magenta) with minimum guaranteed sessions.
Drop AC chargers at low-traffic sites; consolidate to fewer DC bays at high-traffic sites (Pareto).

challenges.title: Interoperability and roaming
challenges.description: Each operator (Tata Power, Ather, Statiq, ChargeZone, Jio-bp, Glida) requires its own app and wallet; OCPI roaming is still patchy.
challenges.impact: User friction, abandoned sessions, and lower utilization for smaller operators.
solutions: Adopt OCPI 2.2.1 from day one and join the Bharat Charge Alliance roaming hub.
Accept open payment (UPI QR + RFID) at every charger; do not require app install for guest sessions.
Publish real-time CSMS feed to PlugShare, Ather Grid, Google Maps EV layer.

challenges.title: Charger reliability and uptime
challenges.description: Industry uptime for DC chargers in India is 88-93%. Failures: connector damage, RFID reader, comms loss, payment hang.
challenges.impact: Lost revenue (each hour of downtime ~ INR 350-900 lost), and PlugShare reviews compound the brand hit.
solutions: CSMS with active polling every 60s and auto-ticket to field-ops if any fault > 15 min.
Stock common spare parts (CCS2 gun INR 28k, contactor INR 6k) within 100 km of each cluster.
Tie OEM SLAs to uptime (>97%) with liquidated damages.

challenges.title: Highway gap and range anxiety
challenges.description: NH48 Chennai-Bengaluru has ~6 working fast chargers; NH44 Salem-Madurai has <4. Long stretches >120 km without reliable DC charging.
challenges.impact: Suppresses 4-wheeler EV adoption for inter-city travel; commercial fleet adoption blocked.
solutions: Target every 60-80 km on NH48/NH44/NH32/ECR; 4x120 kW CCS2 + 1x240 kW per highway site.
Apply under MHI PM-eDrive scheme (CapEx subsidy up to 70% for highway DC).
Anchor highway sites at existing fuel retail / Highway food courts (A1 Plaza, Adyar Ananda Bhavan highway branches).

challenges.title: Vandalism and safety
challenges.description: Unmanned sites face cable theft, connector damage, and EV-on-fire incidents (rare but high-impact).
challenges.impact: Insurance premiums up 30-50% YoY; site shutdowns post-incident.
solutions: 24x7 IP camera + motion alerts; tie-up with local security agency for night patrol.
Mandatory IEC 61851 + AIS 138 compliant chargers; thermal cutoff on every bay.
Public liability insurance INR 1 crore per site.

challenges.title: Skilled technician shortage
challenges.description: Few certified EV charger technicians in Tier-2 TN towns; OEM training pipelines just starting.
challenges.impact: MTTR (mean time to repair) is 36-72 hours in Tier-2; 6-12 hours in Chennai.
solutions: Sponsor 2-week certification under ASDC (Automotive Skills Dev Council) for ITI graduates; hire-and-train model.
Regional ops hubs (Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy) each owning 5-8 stations within 80 km.
